_about: The Soul Mixer's tables, rebuilt because the game's own were never preserved (tools/soul_mixer_wiki.py makes this file; DECISIONS.md, 20 October 2026). Used only when the game's config has no Soul Mixer tables of its own, so a genuine original config replaces it.

sources.wiki: Social Empires Tips Wiki, "Soul Mixer Combinations" (socialempirestips.fandom.com), as saved by the owner on 20 October 2026
sources.strength: ours: the unit's attack times life over its attack interval, ranked from 10 to 399 (the gods, colossi and newest dragon sets from 400 to 520, where the original rolls a random result)
sources.recipe: ours: moved by a seeded search so the wiki's recipes can give their results through the original's mixing rules (seed 1, 40000 steps)
sources.wait: the wiki's 3 hours for the weakest to its 5 days 10 hours for the strongest, growing evenly by rank (ours, between those)

SOUL_MIXER_MIN_LEVEL.source: ours: the level the shop sells the Soul Mixer at; the wiki doesn't say

SOUL_MIXER_POWERUPS_LEVELS.source: wiki: "+1 = 1 Cash Powerup", "+3 = 1 Cash + 2 Cash", up to "+7"; ours: 3 to 7 cash beyond, and each power-up one unit up
